Initial release: Provides a structured process for creating effective risk-reversal guarantees on offers.

- Offers guidance to select, word, and recommend a guarantee type (Unconditional, Conditional, Anti, Performance-based) based on product context and fulfillment cost.
- Includes checklists and questions to gather essential product, pricing, and cost information before proceeding.
- Supplies template wording and ROI projection methodology to help balance conversion increase vs. refund risk.
- Covers both single and stacked guarantees, including advice on when to use guarantee enhancements.
- Points to related skills for full offer design and value auditing.
